scenes.title: Find the [[last purchase rate]] instantly
scenes.tamil: ஒரு item-ஓட கடைசி purchase rate உடனே தெரியணுமா?
scenes.say: Find the last purchase rate of any item instantly.
The minus one tells XLOOKUP to search from the bottom, so you get the latest rate.

scenes.en: Sheet "P": date order, item in B, rate in D
Item name in A2 of your report
